FABRIC
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: photorealistic architectural visualization for an immersive projection mapping moodboard, single wide 16:9 image. Use supplied hall model only as room geometry reference: three projection walls form a U around the audience. Camera at standing eye height inside the center of the rectangular hall, facing the long back wall with left and right walls receding toward its two corners. The stage is BEHIND the camera, so no stage, stage back wall, stairs or reverse side visible. Architecture: black ceiling, dark polished patterned marble floor, warm bronze details. VERY WIDE, LOW panoramic projection bands on THREE VERTICAL WALLS only, approximately 13.5:1 total unwrapped image ratio, wall projection top and bottom crisp boundaries. Floor is NOT a screen, ceiling NOT a screen, only subtle reflected spill is allowed. No dome, no spherical cinema, no projected imagery on ceiling or floor. No audience people, no text, logos, watermarks or UI. Clear room corners, coherent perspective and plausible architectural lighting. Cinematic but legible, high quality interior render. Primary request: show how continuous golden silk content looks on the three walls of the room. The wall projection is entirely covered in softly flowing translucent champagne-gold silk, large elegant folds lit from within and below, soft breeze apparent in frozen shape, layers of gauze, subtle warm shadows and amber highlights. Material and palette from the attached drapery reference; do not reproduce its stage or text. Restrained luxurious atmosphere. Walls are projections of fabric, not real hanging curtains blocking the room. Main feature is cloth texture and light, not abstract glowing energy.

Primary request: show an illusion of a deep colonnaded hall projected on the three walls. Gauzy translucent gold fabric floats in elegant arcs between virtual columns, showing depth. Projection content remains inside horizontal wall bands. Actual floor and actual roof remain dark and unprojected. This is a visual illusion drawn on flat walls, not construction of actual columns in the room. Calm rich amber light, deep dark distant corridors.

No audience people, no text, logos, watermarks or UI. Clear room corners, coherent perspective and plausible architectural lighting. Cinematic but legible, high quality interior render. Primary request: illustrate the second part of the Yakut / Sakha performance: base wall fill is dim warm ochre-gray atmospheric gradient, mostly calm negative space. In different positions on the THREE WALLS, three separated story scenes appear ONLY INSIDE IRREGULAR SMOKY FEATHERED WINDOWS, as if viewed through billowing wisps of fog that dissolve into the base fill. No hard geometric borders, no circles, no obvious rings. Center wall window: a Sakha Siberian shaman holding a frame drum in a remote steppe setting, subtle realistic details; left wall window: wide Lena Pillars and river landscape; right wall window: everyday rural Sakha family life, small figures, northern natural setting. These are flat projected scenes in mist windows on the walls; no people physically standing in the hall. Scene edges have very soft organic smoky dissolves. Not Chinese, no pagodas, no Chinese mountains or ornaments. Do not fill entire walls with a single landscape.

Primary request: illustrate dynamic plastic dance accompaniment on almost BLACK wall projections. Fine luminous GOLD particles and champagne trails form flowing vortex streams travelling continuously around the THREE walls, with large black negative spaces. In one local area on the back wall a small symbolic human silhouette is coalescing from the particles, another portion dissolves and drifts back into a stream. Show graceful musical swirls and curls, depth, no explosion, no fireworks, no cosmic nebula rainbow. Walls remain clearly flat projection surfaces with corner continuity, floor unprojected. Gold on black, intense movement implied but readable elegant form.
